notes.title: 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Today's patch is focused on fixing a couple of issues that have come up since release.

- All of the shop menus have been re-designed to prevent a rare bug which prevented item listings from appearing for some players. This seemed to happen more regularly on a second play through.

- Retrieving the "black feather" should now be more user-friendly for those using controller/keyboard.

I'm also aware of an issue with certain menu options (such as "always dash") resetting when you restart the game, but I'm still working on a fix for that. Let me know if you have any more problems!
